title: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
resourceType: Agent-native reverse-engineering toolkit with CLI, MCP and guided investigation workflows
purpose: 讓 AI agent 以一致、可追溯的流程分析沒有原始碼的軟體，從 binary、JavaScript/Electron、runtime observation 與 evidence reconstruction 理解功能如何運作，再把理解結果轉成適合自己技術棧的實作。
recommendation: 適合需要理解既有應用功能、Electron/JavaScript app、native binary 或跨層行為的人。核心價值不是單純 decompile，而是把 reverse engineering 包成 agent 可操作的 investigation workflow，並要求 evidence-backed conclusions，降低 agent 靠猜測重建功能的風險。
notes: REA exposes reverse-engineering capabilities through CLI and MCP and bundles a guided routing skill. Its documented investigation model is Decompile → Understand → Recreate. Analysis is local by design; REA states it does not upload the analyzed app to a hosted analysis service. It provides reproducible evidence records and distinguishes static inference from runtime observation.
